title: Rewards: knowledge and invited performance
summary: A reward claimant’s awareness of an offer differs from the claimant’s motive for performing.
notes: Broadnax is used for the need to act in response to a known reward offer. Knowledge can allow an acceptance even if the performer has other motives. The notes ask what happens when a claimant learns of the offer after beginning the requested activity and point to Restatement § 51. They do not invite dispensing with notice merely because the advertiser benefited.
